non_overlap_policy: These are existing source records, not 954 newly acquired sessions.
Historical registry baseline may already include these sessions; never add 954 without reconciling source-period overlap.
Raw EVOpsSession transaction records and observed site/period aggregates overlap and must not be summed together.
Source status INVALID/ABORTED excluded from successful observed charging counts.
A date when Evercraft checked a dataset is not the publisher observation date.
Facility coordinates are verified anchors, not physical charger GPS.
Incomplete September publication is not evidence of low remaining-month utilization.
